headline: Saving the qualified graph activation checkpoint.
focus: T10 · Native graph receipts verified; integration commit and PR merge remain pending
summary: Integrated graph checks and selected Linux/Mac hardware procedures pass on the same frozen runtime. Scoped gain, delay, tail, ownership, and muted validation evidence is retained. T10 stays active until shipping; M2, full-worker real-time, DAC/acoustic, and release qualification remain incomplete.

M0.detail: Contracts and backend risk spikes exist. The GUI toolkit decision remains open.

M1.detail: The joined player passed scoped Linux and Mac acceptance and is saved in ecd7572. The GUI shell and broader qualification remain open; M1 is not complete.

M2.detail: Scoped single-rate PCM graph activation passed selected Linux and Mac procedures. Shipping remains pending. Broader DSP-player, full-worker real-time, and release qualification remain incomplete.

M3.detail: Network adapters, timing, DSD, and arbitration remain ahead.

M4.detail: Release qualification requires the full published evidence matrix.

checks.title: Linux 307 · Mac 289 passed
checks.detail: Each canonical run ignored two gated tests. The separate 11-test Mac silent SDK recheck also passes and overlaps its canonical count.

checks.title: 48,007 Linux graph frames
checks.detail: 48,000 source frames plus seven tail frames were submitted and client-estimated consumed. Zero saturation; source/mixer unchanged; graph resources retired.

checks.title: 24,003 Mac graph frames
checks.detail: 24,000 source frames plus three tail frames were submitted. Consumption and audible position remain unknown; source and selected device snapshot stayed unchanged.

checks.title: Muted transaction check passes
checks.detail: Mac validation returned no runtime token or revision change. Prepare/commit stayed muted, hashes matched, and zero frames were submitted. Shipping remains pending.

verified.title: Lossless decoding and exact continuity
verified.detail: WAV, FLAC, and AIFF preserve integer PCM without a floating-point intermediate. Private acceptance covers 51 exact PCM cases and 288,000 exact split-track frames. Four DoP inputs reject; one RF64 case is unsupported; 34 cases remain outside the qualified subset.

verified.title: Saved owner foundation
verified.detail: Commit 754086c includes local IPC, bounded queues, safe restart, and scoped independent review. Its Linux 150 and macOS 140 test results apply to that foundation.

verified.title: Playback integration saved
verified.detail: Playback integration ecd7572 and dashboard commit 9d26b6d merged in PR #1 as ced893b. Scoped Linux/Mac acceptance and safety/drain/logging regressions retain their redacted evidence. T08/T09 are scoped done; M0/M1 and release gates remain incomplete.

verified.title: Playback foundation CLI and worker boundaries
verified.detail: Five independent CLI scenarios and six real-worker cases pass: exact capture, attenuation, per-item failure, pause/seek/resume, failing diagnostics, running stop, reservation protection, EOF seek, incompatible transition, and fault revocation. Controlled ALSA lifecycle tests and the separately gated native procedures retain their own evidence boundaries.

verified.title: Frozen platform canonical checks
verified.detail: The frozen graph snapshot passed Linux 307 and Mac 289 canonical tests, with two ignored on each platform. Formatting, strict Clippy, catalog, and dependency checks pass. The separate Mac silent SDK recheck passed 11 tests and overlaps canonical coverage. All 1,441 Mac archive inputs matched before and after.

verified.title: Scoped native graph activation acceptance
verified.detail: One selected attenuated graph signal passed on each platform. Linux submitted and client-estimated consumed 48,007 frames, including seven tail frames, with zero saturation and retired resources. Mac submitted 24,003 frames, including three tail frames; consumed/audible fields remain unknown. Sources, Mac device snapshot, and Linux mixer stayed unchanged. These modified routes do not prove DAC or acoustic preservation.

verified.title: Safety and diagnostic regressions fixed
verified.detail: The stop/mute saturation failure was reproduced before reserved FIFO control capacity fixed normal-command pressure. Three actual-channel tests and ten core local-control cases pass. A real failing-stderr subprocess passes with best-effort diagnostic writes. Focused review and the final Linux canonical run pass.

verified.title: Linux physical and zero-PCM drain acceptance passed
verified.detail: After the preserved failure, the final owned-tone run reached idle with no error: 48,000 submitted and client-estimated consumed frames, backend delay zero, source and mixer unchanged, and modified preservation. The zero-PCM regression passed 48,000 frames with 11 pending observations, one drain call, and zero drain-time parameter rewrites. No fallback occurred; DAC and acoustic preservation remain unverified.

verified.title: Reviewed compiler and prepared runtime checks
verified.detail: Reviewed compiler/runtime changes are integrated. Focused compiler, prepared execution, allocator, and render-bridge scenarios pass; the integrated owner/CLI checkpoint has nine passing real scenarios. Platform canonical and scoped native graph procedures pass on the same frozen runtime. Full-worker real-time qualification remains partial.

verified.title: Graph preparation and retirement lifecycle
verified.detail: The preparation/retirement service has 22 passing tests, with reviewed ownership/capacity fixes imported. Final Linux graph resources report zero resident bytes, no pending retirement, and no preparing/candidate state. Independent integrated-contract review found no remaining important or critical findings.

verified.title: Integrated graph owner and CLI checkpoint
verified.detail: Nine real owner/CLI/native-file scenarios pass: exact delay/gain across two files with one tail, competing/unsafe/resource rejection preserving the plan, pause/seek/resume exact suffix, and real restart muted without runtime tokens. Additional muted Mac validation/prepare/commit passes with matching hashes, no token or revision change from validation, and zero submitted frames.

active.title: Save and ship reviewed graph integration
active.detail: Native receipts are verified. T10 stays active while the integration commit and PR merge remain pending. Scoped native acceptance does not complete M2 or release qualification.

active.title: Broader DSP and real-time qualification
active.detail: Full-worker real-time evidence remains partial. PEQ, convolution, resampling, profiles, and broader DSP-player workflows remain unfinished or unqualified.

active.title: GUI and independent physical measurement
active.detail: GUI and broader route qualification stay open. Mac physical consumption and audible position remain unknown. Linux consumption is client-estimated; independent DAC and acoustic preservation are unverified.

pending.title: Approved: hardware playback and evidence
pending.detail: Doctor Biz granted approval. Mac and Linux physical routes have now been exercised; each result retains its own boundary.

pending.title: Exercised: selected graph routes passed
pending.detail: One attenuated graph signal passed on each selected route. Linux submitted 48,007 frames; Mac submitted 24,003. Sources and recorded device state stayed unchanged. Mac also passed the separate zero-signal muted transaction check.

pending.title: Measured: client boundaries; DAC unknown
pending.detail: Linux reports client-estimated consumption, delay zero, and saturation zero. Mac submitted frames are known while consumption/audible fields remain null. These boundaries do not establish physical consumption, DAC preservation, or acoustic qualification.

activity.title: Native graph receipts verified on both platforms
activity.detail: Linux passed 48,000 source plus seven tail frames; Mac passed 24,000 source plus three tail frames. Sources and recorded device state stayed unchanged. T10 shipping remains pending.

activity.title: Platform graph canonical checks passed
activity.detail: Linux 307 and Mac 289 tests passed, with two ignored on each. The separate 11-test Mac silent SDK recheck overlaps canonical coverage. All 1,441 Mac archive inputs matched before and after.

activity.title: Muted Mac validation transaction passed
activity.detail: Validation produced no runtime token or revision change. Prepared hashes matched, prepare/commit stayed muted, and submitted frames stayed zero.

activity.title: Owner/CLI graph checkpoint and review passed
activity.detail: Nine real owner/CLI cases and 22 preparation/retirement tests pass. Independent integrated-contract review found no remaining important or critical findings.

activity.title: Qualification limits remain explicit
activity.detail: This checkpoint covers bounded single-rate PCM graphs and selected routes. M2, full-worker real-time, DAC/acoustic, and release qualification remain incomplete.
